payload.title: Image toolchain: regenerate existing generated images under the current style profile
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-07 wants every existing generated image on a Story or Reference re-generated under the new image types and style profiles once the toolchain can generate. Plan: (1) an inventory that counts, per publication and image type, the images whose provenance says they were generated, read through an index, never a table scan (the index may need adding, one per table per deploy); (2) a dry run that lists what would be regenerated and an estimate (unpriced until the trial measures tokens per image); (3) one single-image request per old image through the unattended Batch lane, spend-approved only for a publication that has approval (today only Machines on Machines, gpt-image-2.5-flare); (4) the old image is never deleted: the new one waits as a candidate in the review queue and is applied according to the site's imageReview setting (after_the_fact sites let it be applied unreviewed), always reversible through image_unapply; (5) each regeneration records which old image it replaces and the profile version used. Depends on build steps 2 to 6 (profile, candidates, OpenAI adapter). Not started; needs Ryan's go for spend and per-publication scope before running.
